verifications.claim: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base on California's Central Coast on April 6, 2026, at 7:49 p.m. PT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites ... from Vandenberg Space Force Base on Monday, April 6, 2026.' 'liftoff ... 7:49 p.m. PT.'; R3: 'Vandenberg Space Force Base along the Central Coast ... carrying 25 Starlink satellites ... Monday evening.'; R1/R4: scheduled April 6, 2026, 25 Starlink from Vandenberg.
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm success, exact number, location (Central Coast via R3/Santa Barbara), date, and time within window/target.

verifications.claim: The Falcon 9 rocket was highly visible across Southern California shortly after sunset.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'just after sunset, visible over Southern California.' 'SpaceX's previous rocket launches were seen ... across Southern California skies.'; R1: viewing spots in Ventura/San Luis Obispo/Santa Barbara, visible to Long Beach/San Diego.
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly states visibility over Southern California just after sunset; 'highly' interpretive but strongly supported.

verifications.claim: The launch was one of many regular launches from Vandenberg Space Force Base.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'SpaceX launches rockets from Vandenberg about once a week'; R1: 'eight rocket launches ... in March ... SpaceX'; R2: 'another batch ... previous SpaceX launches'; R4: multiple Starlink missions scheduled weekly.
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe frequent SpaceX launches from Vandenberg, confirming regularity.
